name: Book Employee with Spouse — Invalid State Then Valid
goal: User enters an invalid state name; bot rejects and user provides a valid state.
constraints: First state input is not in allowed list; second is valid.

phases.description: User provides spouse details, appointment date, and mobile number.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name, DOB, appointment date, and mobile.
Bot replies with 'This is not a state where we have this facility. Please try another location.'
Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
